top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a discrete, foundational and extensively validated account of adaptive immunity: Miller's thymus-derived T-cell work and Cooper's bursa-equivalent B-cell lineage work are complementary, lineage-defining contributions with a proportionate two-person attribution. The scope must remain confined to those distinct lineages rather than the whole subsequent development of cellular immunology.
recusal_note: I have a documented research connection through co-authored works with committee member Thomas Perlmann. No connection to the proposed laureates is apparent from the supplied profile.
